primary_locator: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9388709/#Sec5 | Prodromal PD attributes and therapeutic advances (Sec5 to Sec6)
assessment: The olfactory measurements come from cohorts compared by GBA1 or Gaucher status. Basil appears separately in the therapeutic review as one of several sources of ursolic acid. The olfactory comparisons do not examine fresh basil intake.

Basil Eldadah is a named discussant in the lucidity session and a speaker on the NIA gerontology division. The ARIC olfactory abstract measures odor identification and MRI integrity in older adults. A separate C. elegans talk examines sleep-dependent changes in olfactory synapses.

PB02-G13 tests oral butanolic Myristica fragrans extract in mice with scopolamine-induced memory impairment. Its maze latencies assess memory. PB03-H08 mentions bradykinesia as a Parkinson feature in a separate study of progranulin and alpha-synuclein.

primary_locator: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9911128/#sec12 | Methods, Results, Discussion and Conflicts of Interest
assessment: Sevitz et al. studied expiratory muscle strength training and cough skill training in 20 participants with movement disorders, including 12 with Parkinson disease. A clinician's fatigue impression is described when adapting exercise repetitions for one participant. Caraway is a company in an author's consulting disclosure.

primary_locator: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12256702/#P1203 | Dietary Supplements and Sleep Health (P2585, P2633-P2634)
assessment: The cited flaxseed supplementation synthesis reports serum lipids. The sleep chapter separately reports daytime sleepiness prevalence in NHANES and its association with cardiovascular outcomes. These analyses do not compare cold-pressed flaxseed oil for sleepiness.

ABS341 examines morphology of lentil storage-protein fibrils extracted at different pH levels for biomaterials. ABS422 and ABS430 discuss structural flexibility or rigidity of proteins in separate presentations. These are material and molecular properties rather than clinical muscle rigidity.

Eleven participants with Parkinson disease crossed over between hypoxia and normoxic placebo while performing treadmill exercise. Hand dexterity was measured with the nine-peg test. Millet is a cited author's surname in hypoxia research.

primary_locator: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7166380/#jns12225-sec-0337 | overwork weakness and immune checkpoint inhibitor neuropathies (sec-0429)
assessment: The overwork-weakness presentation studies hand strength and dexterity in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease. Bédat-Millet is a coauthor of the separate immune checkpoint inhibitor neuropathy presentation.

A142 is a case of Amanita phalloides poisoning treated with extracorporeal blood purification. A156 describes manual dexterity required of operators performing ultrasound-guided peripheral cannulation. These are separate presentations.

P0240 is an MRI feasibility study of gastrointestinal motility after a commercial soup meal in healthy volunteers. P1501 describes the manual dexterity needed to handle proctology equipment and training with a simulator. The soup and dexterity contexts are separate presentations.
